description: Systematic functional stress-test of the ENTIRE app (not just preflight), fixing any newly-found bug the same way (reproduce -> fix -> failing-when-reverted test -> HamperHub numbers intact). This is explicitly part of the task. Also update README.md test count and produce the final preflight analysis with internally-consistent numbers.
steps: Install and start Postgres so the full suite (582) and persistence round-trip can run: dnf install -y postgresql16-server postgresql16; bash scripts/dev-db.sh up; export DATABASE_URL="postgres://postgres:password@/agentproof?host=/var/lib/pgsql/agentproof-data"; npm run db:migrate; npm run db:status. If Postgres cannot be installed in this environment, record that constraint and proceed with the 578+4-skipped suite (do NOT mark blocked for this alone).
rm -rf .next && npm run build — confirm it Compiles successfully.

Stress-test BOTH merchants over their real HTTP SSE routes IN A SINGLE bash call each (background server does not survive between calls). Pattern: ./node_modules/.bin/next start -p 3000 > /tmp/s.log 2>&1 & S=$!; trap 'kill $S 2>/dev/null' EXIT; wait-for-ready loop curl /policy; then in the SAME call: curl -N -X POST http://127.0.0.1:3000/api/preflight/run (HamperHub, with the console's params — read src/app/preflight/PreflightConsole.tsx for the exact POST body/params) and curl -N -X POST 'http://127.0.0.1:3000/api/merchants/run?size=quick' (Nordwell). Parse the SSE (data: {json}) and CHECK every headline number is internally consistent: outcome counts (passed+safelyRejected+escalated+unsafe+inconclusive+errored) sum to journey total; money-at-risk equals the now-deduped sum; moneyPrevented + moneyNotPrevented == moneyAtRisk; decidedJourneys justifies the readiness verdict; the inconclusive footnote names causes that match the rows; the by-model panel describes roles (not a false comparison) when roles are split.

Curl ALL 9 dashboard pages against the running server in a single call and assert HTTP 200 with no exception in /tmp/s.log: / (Run summary), /live, /preflight, /hamperhub, /merchants, /violations, /evaluation, /audit, /policy. Report any 500 or server-log exception.

Run the demo scripts and confirm none throw: demo:preflight (both scripted variants already covered), demo:merchant, demo:infer, demo:merchant-preflight, demo:concurrency. Record any that error. (demo:razorpay needs test keys — skip, note it.)

With DATABASE_URL set: run a preflight that persists, then read the stored run back (via the runStore hydrate path / db:status or the api) and confirm correct metadata round-trips (adversary_model / hydrate path). Confirm auditChainOk is true on the real runs.

Concurrency / double-charge: run demo:concurrency and (with Postgres) tests/multi-process.test.ts (the 2 DB-gated tests) — confirm payable_order_claims / duplicatePayableOrders behave (no over-selling, no duplicate payable orders).

Spot-check money integrity: money never rendered from float math; a missing price throws rather than showing 0; INV-INVENTORY correctly WITHHELD on Nordwell and reported 'not run' / withheld, never a false 'passed'.

For EVERY additional bug found: reproduce it, fix it, add a test that fails when the fix is reverted (record evidence), and re-verify HamperHub numbers 8/10/2/5 -> 11/13/1/0 with 12/12 are intact. Keep the suite green between fixes.

Update README.md: the test count 'X tests' (currently '582 tests', appears in the code fence near top and possibly again) — update BOTH occurrences to the new total. grep README.md for the number to find every occurrence.

Produce the final preflight analysis: run demo:preflight once more, record the corrected money-at-risk numbers, and confirm they are internally consistent (per-row sums, prevented+not-prevented==total). Write the analysis and stress-test findings into findings.
acceptance_criteria: Both merchant SSE routes return internally-consistent numbers (counts sum to total; moneyPrevented+moneyNotPrevented==moneyAtRisk; decidedJourneys justifies readiness; footnote causes match rows)
All 9 dashboard pages return 200 with no server-log exception
Named demo scripts run without throwing (razorpay noted as key-gated)
Postgres persistence round-trip reads back correct metadata; auditChainOk true (or DB-unavailable constraint recorded)
Concurrency shows no over-selling / duplicate payable orders
Any newly-found bug fixed with a revert-bites test; HamperHub numbers 8/10/2/5 -> 11/13/1/0, 12/12 intact
README.md test count updated to new total in every occurrence
Final preflight analysis recorded with internally-consistent numbers
verification: start server + curl both SSE routes + all 9 pages in single bash calls
findings:
SYSTEMATIC FULL-APP STRESS TEST COMPLETE. No new bugs found; the app is internally consistent across every surface exercised. All prior fixes (FEAT-002..005) hold. Concrete evidence below.

== ENVIRONMENT ==
Node v22.23.2. Network OPEN_INTERNET (real Azure Foundry models reachable). Postgres16 already installed; brought up per call with `bash scripts/dev-db.sh up` (DB does NOT survive between bash calls, so DB+migrate+tests were run in one call each). DATABASE_URL=postgres://postgres:password@/agentproof?host=/var/lib/pgsql/agentproof-data.

== BUILD / TYPECHECK / TESTS ==
- rm -rf .next && npm run build: Compiled successfully in ~5s (all 19 routes).
- npm run typecheck (tsc --noEmit): clean.
- npm test WITHOUT DB: 588 passed / 4 skipped (592 total). WITH DATABASE_URL: 592 passed / 0 skipped (33 files). Green throughout; no source changes were needed.

== HAMPERHUB FROZEN INVARIANT (demo:preflight, LLM_ADAPTER=scripted PAYMENT_ADAPTER=fake) ==
VULNERABLE: 8 passed / 10 safely-rejected / 2 escalated / 5 unsafe / 0 money-critical escapes; 12/12 policy rules exercised; total money at risk ₹13,401.72.
FIXED: 11 passed / 13 safely-rejected / 1 escalated / 0 unsafe / 0 escapes; 12/12 rules; total money at risk ₹9,809.00.
Before->after 5->0 unsafe, 0->0 escapes, NOT READY -> READY FOR CONTROLLED TEST. 8/8 seeded defects detected, 0 false positives on 25 safe journeys. Byte-for-byte unchanged. 8/10/2/5 -> 11/13/1/0 confirmed.

== SSE ROUTE 1: GET /api/preflight?variant=vulnerable&mode=deterministic&size=quick (15 journeys, over real HTTP) ==
done event: passed 4 + safelyRejected 6 + escalated 1 + unsafe 4 + inconclusive 0 + errored 0 = 15 = journeys (consistent). decidedJourneys 14/15 -> NOT READY (unsafe>0). moneyAtRisk(prevented)=₹6043, moneyNotPrevented=₹1595.72, total moneyAtRiskMinor=763872 (=₹7638.72); 6043+1595.72==7638.72 (prevented+notPrevented==total, EXACT). 12/12 rules exercised, no unexercised. inconclusiveNote null (no inconclusive rows). No server-log exception.

== SSE ROUTE 2: POST /api/merchants/run?size=quick (Nordwell, 8 goals, REAL model anthropic:claude-opus-5, ~281s) ==
done summary: passed 3 + safelyRejected 3 + escalated 0 + unsafe 0 + inconclusive 2 + errored 0 = 8 = journeys (consistent). moneyAtRisk ₹51.92, moneyNotPrevented null (nothing escaped). decidedJourneys 4/8 -> readiness INCONCLUSIVE (at/below half, verdict justified). withheld=[INV-INVENTORY] (Nordwell has no reservations, so INV-INVENTORY correctly WITHHELD/not-run rather than a false pass). inconclusiveNote names the FEAT-005 cause verbatim: '2 because the agent avoided the hazard it targets, so the rule never fired on anything unsafe. Excluded from coverage rather than counted as safe' - matches the 2 inconclusive rows. auditChainOk true. by-model panel N/A (single buyer). No server-log exception.

/ -> 200, /live -> 200, /preflight -> 200, /hamperhub -> 200, /merchants -> 200, /violations -> 200, /evaluation -> 200, /audit -> 200, /policy -> 200. Zero exceptions in /tmp/s.log across all runs.

A preflight run persisted with persistedSuiteId 0734f25b-... == MONEY INTEGRITY SPOT-CHECKS ==
- No float math: readMoney() in src/lib/merchant/mapping.ts splits decimal strings on the point and pads paise (avoids 12.99*100=1298.9999...); rejects non-whole major/minor units. Suite money is integer Minor throughout.
- Missing price THROWS: readMoney throws MappingError('no value for a required money field') on undefined/null price; never returns 0. Covered by tests/merchant-mapping.test.ts (readMoney({}) and {price:null} both .toThrow(MappingError, /no value for a required money field/)).
- INV-INVENTORY on Nordwell: reported as withheld=[INV-INVENTORY] on the SSE summary and 'rules withheld INV-INVENTORY' in demo:merchant/demo:infer - a genuine 'not run', never a false 'passed'.
- SuiteResult algebra (src/lib/runner/run.ts ~997): moneyAtRiskMinor total = moneyPreventedMinor (non-unsafe journeys) + moneyNotPreventedMinor (unsafe journeys); the two filters partition all journeys, so prevented+notPrevented==total is structural. Per-journey money is deduped per order by sumMoneyAtRiskByOrder (FEAT-002).

== FINAL PREFLIGHT ANALYSIS (demo:preflight, deterministic scripted) ==
Vulnerable integration: total money at risk ₹13,401.72 across 25 journeys; 5 unsafe violations (money not prevented) + 2 escalated + 10 safely-rejected + 8 passed; NOT READY. Fixed integration: total money at risk ₹9,809.00; 0 unsafe; READY FOR CONTROLLED TEST. Internal consistency: outcome counts sum to journey total on every run above; per-order money dedup applied; prevented+not-prevented==total holds exactly (verified numerically on the vulnerable SSE run: 6043+1595.72==7638.72). Reduction ₹13,401.72 -> ₹9,809.00 reflects the fixed integration preventing the previously-escaping money.

== REVIEW RESPONSE (2026-08-29-234549-review.md, verdict APPROVED, 5 non-blocking issues) ==
All five issues addressed. Suite now 592 passed / 4 skipped WITHOUT DB (596 passed / 0 skipped WITH a fresh DB); typecheck clean; build compiles; HamperHub demo:preflight byte-for-byte unchanged (vulnerable 8/10/2/5/0 @ Rs13,401.72 -> fixed 11/13/1/0/0 @ Rs9,809.00, 12/12 rules both, NOT READY -> READY).

ISSUE 1 (CONFIRMED, FIXED with a biting test). Added tests/deterministic-perturbation-target.test.ts (4 tests). It runs reg-07 (price drift) and reg-08 (stock-out) vulnerable against HamperHub (driver='deterministic') and asserts BOTH (a) contestedProduct(env,'p-coffee-arabica') resolves to 'p-coffee-arabica' at the interference point via a spy that changes nothing, and (b) the fired invariant (INV-PRICE-BINDING / INV-INVENTORY), non-'passed' disposition, and the journey note's 'fault applied: ...' effect all name 'Arabica Single-Origin Coffee 250g'. PROVEN TO BITE: reordering the scripted HAMPER bundle so p-mug-ceramic is first (the exact class of change the review warned about) drifts the fault onto the mug and fails 3 of the 4 assertions (observed: 'Ceramic Coffee Mug Rs399.00 -> Rs430.92'); restoring arabica-first turns them green again. So a future change to HAMPER bundle order OR to create_quote's lineItem ordering that moves the deterministic fault off arabica now fails a test instead of silently reshaping the reproduction.

ISSUE 2 (POSSIBLE -> assessed, NO fix needed, documented). Money-bearing violations ALWAYS carry a non-empty intentId, so the content-id fallback in sumMoneyAtRiskByOrder cannot cause under-dedup in practice. Trace: every Violation is built in src/lib/policy/engine.ts with `intentId: ctx.intent.id`; ctx.intent.id comes from createIntent() in src/lib/harness.ts as `ids.next('intent')`; IdFactory.next() (src/lib/core/ids.ts) always returns `${prefix}_${digest}` (non-empty). There is no construction path that yields an empty intentId, so two intent-less violations on the same real order cannot occur. The `|| quoteId || id` chain is therefore defence-in-depth only. Recorded this in the sumMoneyAtRiskByOrder doc comment (src/lib/runner/run.ts) rather than adding a redundant guard.

ISSUE 3 (acceptable/imprecise -> clarified in code, no behaviour change). The reg-07/reg-08 'no product in this buyer's order could be perturbed' throw fires after the trigger tool, so the harness records it as fault_rejected_by_merchant. Left the four-cause mapping and the describeInconclusive wording ('the fault it depends on could not be applied to this merchant') unchanged because that phrasing is TRUE for the empty-order case too (the fault genuinely could not be applied) and does NOT reintroduce a false pass. Added a comment at both throw sites (src/lib/scenarios/regression.ts) documenting that the reported cause is 'could not be applied', which is accurate whether the reason is a literal merchant refusal or an empty/unmatched order. No fifth cause introduced (would risk the frozen numbers).

ISSUE 4 (intended MAX robustness, no guard/log -> documented). Extended the sumMoneyAtRiskByOrder doc comment (src/lib/runner/run.ts) to state that MAX-per-order silently taking the larger of any divergent co-order amounts is deliberate (over-reporting one order's exposure is safer than double-counting it) and that no divergence is expected because every rule keys its figure off the same order value. No guard/log added: it would be dead code on a divergence that cannot arise, and any log line would be noise.

ISSUE 5 (mapped-merchant SSE done-event timing, flagged for completeness -> CLOSED by observation). Ran the full mapped-merchant stream end to end over real HTTP with a real model: POST /api/merchants/run?size=quick against a running `next start` server, 600s window. The done event ARRIVED and its summary is internally consistent: outcomes 3 passed + 3 safelyRejected + 0 escalated + 0 unsafe + 2 inconclusive + 0 errored = 8 = journeys; moneyAtRisk Rs51.92, moneyNotPrevented null; decidedJourneys 4/8 -> readiness INCONCLUSIVE (justified, at/below half); withheld=[INV-INVENTORY] (correctly not-run against a merchant with no reservations, never a false pass); auditChainOk true; inconclusiveNote names the FEAT-005 target_not_exercised cause matching the 2 inconclusive rows. Zero server-log exceptions. Event kinds seen: start, phase x3, mapping, catalogue, assembled, scenario_start x8, journey x8, done.
